## How to read this page

::: {.concise-only}
Pick a **Y-axis metric** (default: oil exports), a **time range** (default: 1979-2026), and **which countries** to compare (default: Iran, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, United States, Russia). Both the line chart (Figure 1) and the choropleth map (Figure 2) update reactively. The map's color scale reflects each country's metric value, aggregated over the selected time range. The map is linked to the chart by default — uncheck **Sync map with chart** to drive the map independently.
:::

::: {.deep-only}
This page collects ~8,500 country-year-metric rows across 18 countries (15 Middle East + United States + Russia + China) and 13 metrics (4 energy, 7 demographics/wealth/economy, 2 military), 1979-2026. The four energy metrics come from the Energy Institute Statistical Review (formerly BP), EIA International Energy Statistics, OPEC, and IEA Oil Market Report; the seven demographic/wealth/economy metrics from World Bank WDI; the two military metrics from SIPRI. Each row carries a source-tier mark (T1 = multi-source verified; T2 = single named source; T3 = derived inference; T4 = rough estimate). The page exposes the tier in the chart tooltip; the dynamic Sources footer at the bottom resolves source IDs to full citations on hover.

The dataset has known gaps the page handles gracefully: 2025-2026 figures are sparse for non-energy metrics (only SIPRI extends to 2025); 2026 has zero rows for population and GDP (so picking those metrics will show data ending 2024-2025). Russia 1979-1991 uses USSR aggregates. Iran 2019-2026 GDP figures use the official rial rate and likely overstate real-dollar GDP (T3 marked). Syria post-2011 and Yemen post-2014 carry wide uncertainty (also T3). The chart will show line gaps where data is missing rather than zero-fill.

A planned Phase-2 layer will add a separate map (Figure 3) showing 2026-war-and-precursor strike events with US/Israel attribution. Not in this version.
:::

::: {.bottom-line}
**Bottom line.** A general-purpose interactive comparison of 18 countries on 13 metrics over 47 years. Default view shows oil exports for Iran, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, United States, and Russia, 1979-2026 — the relative-fortunes story for Iran's most consequential regional and global energy peers. Switch the Y-axis to **GDP per capita** to see the divergence in living standards; switch to **military spending** to see where the burden actually falls; switch to **population** for the demographic baseline. Add or remove countries from the legend to retell the story for a different comparison set. The map under the chart visualises whichever metric is selected as a choropleth (color = the country's mean or sum over the selected years).
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Methodology — data sources, tier discipline, and what the page does *not* show

**Data assembly.** The energy data merges six series (Energy Institute Statistical Review 1965-2023, EIA International Energy Statistics 1980-2024, EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook 2025-2026 forecasts, OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2024 cross-validation for OPEC members, IEA Oil Market Report April 2026 for war-period 2026 deltas, plus this project's internal `oil_gas_db` for 2024-2026 detail). The demographic/wealth/economy data comes from World Bank WDI via the public API. Military spending is SIPRI MILEX (April 2026 release, covering 1949-2025). All ~8,500 rows resolve to one of nine source IDs documented in the footer.

**Tier discipline.** Every row carries a source-tier mark visible in the chart tooltip: T1 (multi-source agreement within ~5%), T2 (single authoritative source), T3 (derived inference), T4 (rough estimate or war-period flux). Roughly 58% of energy rows are T1; the demographics rows are mostly T2 because the IMF WEO API used for cross-validation is bot-blocked, so a single-source (World Bank) reading is the working baseline. Iran post-2019 GDP figures are T3 because sanctions-era rial-USD conversion is unreliable; the IRR-USD parallel rate suggests Iran's real-dollar GDP is meaningfully lower than the World Bank figures show.

**What the page does not show.** Missing-data cells are left blank rather than zero-filled — Lebanon and Jordan have no oil/gas exports of consequence (their lines disappear if you select an energy metric), and 2025-2026 has zero coverage for population and GDP (so picking those metrics caps the time series at 2024). This is by design: zero-filling would mis-encode "no exports" as identical to "no data." The choropleth's missing countries are rendered in light gray.

**Aggregation over time on the map.** The map color encodes either the *sum* (for flow metrics like oil exports) or the *mean* (for stock metrics like population, GDP per capita, percentages) over the selected time range. Toggle "Sync map with chart" off to give the map its own time range — useful for comparing a chart-period story against a map-period baseline.

**Phase 2 — bombing intensity overlay (forthcoming).** A separate map (Figure 3) will add 2026-war-and-precursor strike events to the page, with US/Israel attribution toggleable independently of Figure 2. Drawn from ACLED + ISW + project corpus + IDF/DOD press releases. Not in this version.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("../data/country-metrics.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
geo = FileAttachment("../data/world-countries-simplified.geojson").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
allCountries = [
  "Bahrain", "China", "Egypt", "Iran", "Iraq", "Israel", "Jordan",
  "Kuwait", "Lebanon", "Oman", "Qatar", "Russia", "Saudi Arabia",
  "Syria", "Turkey", "United Arab Emirates", "United States", "Yemen"
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
defaultCountries = [
  "Iran", "Saudi Arabia", "Iraq", "United States", "Russia"
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
metricMeta = ({
  oil_exports:               { label: "Oil exports (Mb/year)",            group: "Energy",                   kind: "flow",  unit: "million barrels per year" },
  oil_production:            { label: "Oil production (Mb/year)",         group: "Energy",                   kind: "flow",  unit: "million barrels per year" },
  gas_exports:               { label: "Gas exports (bcm/year)",           group: "Energy",                   kind: "flow",  unit: "billion cubic metres per year" },
  gas_production:            { label: "Gas production (bcm/year)",        group: "Energy",                   kind: "flow",  unit: "billion cubic metres per year" },
  population:                { label: "Population",                       group: "Demographics & wealth",    kind: "stock", unit: "persons" },
  gdp_nominal_usd:           { label: "GDP nominal (USD)",                group: "Demographics & wealth",    kind: "stock", unit: "current USD" },
  gdp_per_capita_usd:        { label: "GDP per capita (USD)",             group: "Demographics & wealth",    kind: "stock", unit: "current USD" },
  gdp_per_capita_ppp:        { label: "GDP per capita PPP (intl USD)",    group: "Demographics & wealth",    kind: "stock", unit: "current international USD" },
  oil_rents_pct_gdp:         { label: "Oil rents (% of GDP)",             group: "Demographics & wealth",    kind: "stock", unit: "percent" },
  trade_pct_gdp:             { label: "Trade (% of GDP)",                 group: "Demographics & wealth",    kind: "stock", unit: "percent" },
  unemployment_rate:         { label: "Unemployment rate (%)",            group: "Demographics & wealth",    kind: "stock", unit: "percent" },
  military_spending_usd:     { label: "Military spending (USD)",          group: "Military",                 kind: "stock", unit: "current USD" },
  military_spending_pct_gdp: { label: "Military spending (% of GDP)",     group: "Military",                 kind: "stock", unit: "percent" }
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
allMetrics = Object.keys(metricMeta)
```

## Controls

```{ojs}
viewof selectedMetric = Inputs.select(allMetrics, {
  label: "Y-axis metric",
  value: "oil_exports",
  format: v => metricMeta[v].label
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof startYear = Inputs.range([1979, 2026], {
  label: "Start year",
  step: 1,
  value: 1979
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof endYear = Inputs.range([1979, 2026], {
  label: "End year",
  step: 1,
  value: 2026
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedCountries = Inputs.checkbox(allCountries, {
  label: "Countries (default: Iran + Saudi Arabia + Iraq + United States + Russia)",
  value: defaultCountries
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof mapLinked = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Sync map time range with chart",
  value: true
})
```

## Figure 1 — Time series

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-timeseries
//| fig-cap: "One line per selected country. Y-axis is the selected metric. Tooltip shows year, country, value, and source-tier."

{
  const meta = metricMeta[selectedMetric];
  const lo = Math.min(startYear, endYear);
  const hi = Math.max(startYear, endYear);

  const filtered = data.filter(d =>
    d.metric === selectedMetric &&
    selectedCountries.includes(d.country) &&
    d.year >= lo && d.year <= hi
  );

  const isMobile = width < 700;
  const baseFont = isMobile ? 13 : Math.max(15, Math.min(20, Math.round(width / 60)));

  const formatY = (v) => {
    if (v == null) return "—";
    if (selectedMetric === "population") {
      if (v >= 1e9) return (v/1e9).toFixed(2) + " B";
      if (v >= 1e6) return (v/1e6).toFixed(1) + " M";
      return v.toLocaleString();
    }
    if (selectedMetric === "gdp_nominal_usd" || selectedMetric === "military_spending_usd") {
      if (v >= 1e12) return "$" + (v/1e12).toFixed(2) + "T";
      if (v >= 1e9) return "$" + (v/1e9).toFixed(1) + "B";
      if (v >= 1e6) return "$" + (v/1e6).toFixed(0) + "M";
      return "$" + v.toLocaleString();
    }
    if (selectedMetric === "gdp_per_capita_usd" || selectedMetric === "gdp_per_capita_ppp") {
      return "$" + Math.round(v).toLocaleString();
    }
    if (meta.unit === "percent") return v.toFixed(1) + "%";
    return v.toLocaleString();
  };

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    return html`<div style="padding:2em;text-align:center;color:#666;font-size:${baseFont}px;">
      No data for this combination of metric, time range, and countries.
      Try a different metric (e.g., switch from oil_exports to population to see Lebanon and Jordan)
      or extend the time range.
    </div>`;
  }

  return Plot.plot({
    width,
    height: isMobile ? 320 : 460,
    marginLeft: isMobile ? 60 : 90,
    marginBottom: 50,
    marginRight: 20,
    marginTop: 30,
    style: {
      fontSize: baseFont + "px",
      fontFamily: "system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"
    },
    grid: true,
    x: { label: "Year", tickFormat: d => String(d) },
    y: {
      label: meta.label + " ↑",
      tickFormat: formatY,
      nice: true,
      grid: true
    },
    color: {
      legend: true,
      domain: selectedCountries
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.line(filtered, {
        x: "year",
        y: "value",
        stroke: "country",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        sort: { color: null }
      }),
      Plot.dot(filtered, {
        x: "year",
        y: "value",
        fill: "country",
        r: 2.5,
        stroke: "white",
        strokeWidth: 0.5
      }),
      Plot.tip(filtered, Plot.pointer({
        x: "year",
        y: "value",
        title: d =>
          `${d.country} — ${d.year}\n${meta.label}: ${formatY(d.value)}\nSource: ${d.source_id} (${d.source_tier})`
      }))
    ]
  });
}
```

## Figure 2 — Map

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-map
//| fig-cap: "Choropleth: each country shaded by its value of the selected metric, aggregated over the map's time range. Selected countries are outlined; unselected are muted. Toggle 'Sync map with chart' off to drive the map's time range independently."

{
  const meta = metricMeta[selectedMetric];

  // Map's time range = chart's range when linked; otherwise full range
  const mapLo = mapLinked ? Math.min(startYear, endYear) : 1979;
  const mapHi = mapLinked ? Math.max(startYear, endYear) : 2026;

  const mapFiltered = data.filter(d =>
    d.metric === selectedMetric &&
    d.year >= mapLo && d.year <= mapHi
  );

  // Aggregate per country: sum for flow, mean for stock
  const isStock = meta.kind === "stock";
  const agg = new Map();
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const row of mapFiltered) {
    if (row.value == null) continue;
    agg.set(row.country, (agg.get(row.country) || 0) + row.value);
    counts.set(row.country, (counts.get(row.country) || 0) + 1);
  }
  if (isStock) {
    for (const [k, v] of agg.entries()) {
      agg.set(k, v / counts.get(k));
    }
  }

  const isMobile = width < 700;
  const baseFont = isMobile ? 12 : Math.max(13, Math.min(16, Math.round(width / 75)));

  // Compute fit-domain from selected countries (auto-zoom)
  const selectedFeatures = geo.features.filter(f =>
    selectedCountries.includes(f.properties.name)
  );
  const fitDomain = selectedFeatures.length > 0
    ? { type: "FeatureCollection", features: selectedFeatures }
    : { type: "FeatureCollection", features: geo.features };

  const formatY = (v) => {
    if (v == null) return "—";
    if (selectedMetric === "population") {
      if (v >= 1e9) return (v/1e9).toFixed(2) + " B";
      if (v >= 1e6) return (v/1e6).toFixed(1) + " M";
      return v.toLocaleString();
    }
    if (selectedMetric === "gdp_nominal_usd" || selectedMetric === "military_spending_usd") {
      if (v >= 1e12) return "$" + (v/1e12).toFixed(2) + "T";
      if (v >= 1e9) return "$" + (v/1e9).toFixed(1) + "B";
      if (v >= 1e6) return "$" + (v/1e6).toFixed(0) + "M";
      return "$" + v.toLocaleString();
    }
    if (selectedMetric === "gdp_per_capita_usd" || selectedMetric === "gdp_per_capita_ppp") {
      return "$" + Math.round(v).toLocaleString();
    }
    if (meta.unit === "percent") return v.toFixed(1) + "%";
    return v.toLocaleString();
  };

  const aggLabel = isStock
    ? `${meta.label} (mean over ${mapLo}-${mapHi})`
    : `${meta.label} (sum over ${mapLo}-${mapHi})`;

  return Plot.plot({
    width,
    height: isMobile ? 360 : 540,
    projection: {
      type: "mercator",
      domain: fitDomain
    },
    style: {
      fontSize: baseFont + "px",
      fontFamily: "system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"
    },
    color: {
      type: meta.unit === "percent" ? "linear" : "sqrt",
      scheme: "blues",
      legend: true,
      label: aggLabel,
      unknown: "#eaeaea"
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(geo, {
        fill: d => agg.get(d.properties.name),
        stroke: d => selectedCountries.includes(d.properties.name) ? "#222" : "#bbb",
        strokeWidth: d => selectedCountries.includes(d.properties.name) ? 1.2 : 0.4,
        title: d => {
          const v = agg.get(d.properties.name);
          if (v == null) return d.properties.name + " — no data for this metric";
          return `${d.properties.name}\n${aggLabel}: ${formatY(v)}`;
        }
      }),
      // Country labels for selected countries only
      Plot.text(geo.features.filter(f => selectedCountries.includes(f.properties.name)), {
        x: d => d3.geoCentroid(d)[0],
        y: d => d3.geoCentroid(d)[1],
        text: d => d.properties.name,
        fontSize: Math.max(9, baseFont - 2),
        fontWeight: 600,
        fill: "#111",
        stroke: "white",
        strokeWidth: 2
      })
    ]
  });
}
```
